As part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] efforts to build their [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|forces]] for an eventual [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a '''meeting''' between the Alliance and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]], leader of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], was arranged. [[Starfighter/Legends|Starfighters]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] were used to watch over the meeting; upon the arrival of [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|mercenary force]], the starfighters were called into action to defeat the intruders. Fey'lya's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|ship]], the [[Jade (Lambda-class)|''Jade'']], managed to reach the Alliance's [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] while the Alliance destroyed the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. One of the [[Unidentified mercenary (Falcon's Nest mercenaries)|mercenaries]] escaped his exploding ship and was captured after the battle. He revealed to the Alliance that his employers were the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], in an effort to cause tension between the two [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, the mercenary group had actually been hired by the Empire in order to sow distrust within the ranks of the Alliance. Eventually, the mercenary's information allowed the Alliance to [[Reconnaissance of mercenary base|track]] the offending mercenary group and [[Battle of Azzameen Station|capture]] their [[Azzameen Station/Legends|headquarters]].
